findings.body: This rejects based on aggregate row count before Actual candidates are constructed or deduplicated. A query with 200 grouped coordinates but only a few clickable Actual values—for example, many budget-only or missing-Actual groups—is rejected even though it is below the required cap of 200 distinct Actual scopes. The added 200/201 test calls `ActualDrillContextService.issue` directly, so it does not exercise or detect this behavior through the real query entry point. Build the candidates, include the total, deduplicate by scope, and apply the cap to that set.
findings.title: Not done: 200/201 Actual-scope cap is enforced on distinct scopes
